required_before_capture: inspect actual power, free storage, software and native control support
stop any previous camera owner cleanly
fresh preview with all targets and no physical changes during paired trials
select non-overlapping flat target/background patches 8..64px in native main coordinates
measure shared focus candidate and colour gains under reference light
record illumination setup and target dimensions; do not infer metres from pixels
repeat_order: randomized in matched stable light; record seed and actual order
acceptance: actual mode/exposure, fixed colour gains and focus observed before samples
complete log and summary; no capture/power/cleanup faults
actual exposure and gain distributions reported for every mode
brightness/controls drift invalidates stationary noise proxy
no winner declaration from static brightness alone
